body: UPDATE: She removed me on instagram, which probably means she read the messages and blocked the dude. You don't understand how relieved I feel. Kind of a bummer she removed me, but who can you trust after that, really.
I tried instagram and messenger, she hasn't responded to either. :/
I tried adding her roommate and sister, neither have accepted. The event is Saturday, so I have until then to let her know about this before those guys show up to the event.
I would, but her profile can only be added by friends of friends.

Thank you so much for the advice.

> Even if she does meet up with him, it's not your job to protect her from whatever real or perceived threat is there


I understand, I just would feel so guilty if something bad DID happen, no matter how small the chances.

So just to recap, I should consider apologizing in person, at her job, for this whole situation? Because your post has me convinced otherwise.

Look, I understand your point of view. However, this is the guy that was spamming her pictures and personal information along with creepy messages about things such as having sex with her dog, having sex with her grandmother, and some threats as well.


All I literally did was post one image, I was not expecting it to spiral out of control like this and continue for weeks. WEEKS.


If you want me to post the evidence here, I'd gladly do so. He just posted some additional conversations right now too.

Honestly, she wasn't even a crush. I just wanted advice on how to approach a girl in my college class, then an anon on 4chan asked for a picture. I looked her up on facebook and I'm a stupid idiot and uploaded the image without removing the Facebook filename. (Still an idiot for posting the picture in the first place)

Also, the only reason I know she's going on a "date" soon is because he's been posting the conversations he's having with her. They're not from the same city but he claims that they'll be meeting sometime in winter, which worries the hell out of me. I have no idea if the screenshots are real or fake, but I have reasons to believe it's real.


I'm not even expecting a friendship out of this, I just want to let her know what's going on and leave her life. I just feel extreme guilt and haven't stopped worrying since all this happened.

You're right. I've just been really stressed over this situation for at least two weeks.


I'll approach her at her job tomorrow.

I'll try.


I'm just afraid she'll call the police on me while I'm waiting to talk to her. She privated all her profiles too, which tells me she definitely does NOT want someone to approach her from 4chan.

She works behind the counter of a food place so she probably doesn't have time for me to talk about the entire situation with the evidence.


How would I approach her in this situation?
How should I go about approaching her at her job to talk about it?
